title: Die Crew: Reist gemeinsam zum 9. Planeten
subtitle: The Cooperative Trick-Taking Space Mission
loreSummary: Astronauts wanted! The scientific community is abuzz over signs of a mysterious ninth planet at the edge of our solar system. Join the crew and undertake 50 increasingly difficult missions to verify its existence.

milestones.title: First Major Hurdle
milestones.description: Complete the initial 10 missions to get the hang of trick-taking.
